That's a soft dismissal. Taylor knows and throws his head back as soon as he sees Gurbaz completing the catch. An innocuous delivery - short and outside off, Taylor's eyes lit up as he saw a scoring opportunity, throws his hands on the cut and the outside-edge flies to the right of the keeper, Gurbaz hangs on and Zimbabwe slip further.
